title.lead: AI is moving fast. We keep it

pillarsHead.description: Every week the AI world throws out a hundred new tools and ten thousand hot takes. We cut through it for owners and operators right here on the Prairies.

pillars.title: Plain-English news
pillars.text: What happened, why it matters to your bottom line, and what (if anything) you should do about it. Read it in five minutes.

pillars.title: Run-it-this-week playbooks
pillars.text: Step-by-step guides built for real small businesses — not enterprise teams with a data department. Copy, paste, done.

pillars.title: A plan for your business
pillars.text: Tell us what you wish AI could do, and we'll map a path — using tools that already exist or a custom setup. No cost to ask.

feature.title: Nobody's Googling you anymore — they're asking ChatGPT. Here's how to show up.
feature.excerpt: AI answer engines are quietly replacing the search results page. We break down exactly how a Saskatoon contractor got named in ChatGPT's answers in six weeks — and the free checklist to do it yourself.
